description: A movie or TV title's own artwork: every TMDB poster, logo (the wordmark / title art) and backdrop (stills) as a decal id with pixel size and preview URLs, plus title, year, tagline and overview. Place one with decals[].id in the same intent as the content (e.g. the real wordmark under the cover art, a still on the back) — sized by width like any decal. Ids come from search_content.
name: get_content
title: Get title artwork
